findings.summary: Lag features (sales_lag1, sales_lag7, sales_mean7) use shift/rolling over the whole frame without groupby store_id, mixing sales across stores and producing wrong features that feed model training and MAE evaluation; first-week dropna also fails to drop per-store warm-up rows.

judge.reason: Identifies lag/rolling features computed without groupby store_id, mixing stores — the exact defect.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: sales_lag7 only equals same weekday last week if there are no missing dates; gaps in a store's history shift it, so reindexing to a full daily range per store would be more robust.

judge.reason: Describes the known problem of missing dates breaking row-based lag7, not the cross-store mixing bug.

findings.label: valid_other
